scope.population: Same selected, nonempty Lauer-derived clone frame only
scope.comparison: Exported-row CDF versus unique-eligible-clone CDF with unchanged means and selectors

assumptions.condition: Inspected source generates the relevant table without alteration, extra row duplication or undocumented loss.
Clone identifiers are stable, nonmissing and one-to-one with clones in the selected Lauer-derived frame; no identity split or merge.
Each retained fit and exported mean is finite numeric; at most one fitted row per clone per run2/run3/run4, and at least one eligible clone remains.
All exported rows of each clone have one identical mean; both CDFs apply the same ancestor exclusions and positive-mean selector, retaining or removing each clone as a whole.
The Lauer-derived component is identified and analyzed separately from the appended barcoded component.

formula_contract.uniform_scope: Sharp supremum over all finite populations of unspecified size and composition; bounds every threshold gap, with no actual distortion estimate.
finite_feasibility: When supplied, J positive integer and J<=N<=K*J
When J is supplied, B_min<=B_max is additionally required
formula_contract.finite_sharpness_scope: Exact attained endpoints given only N,k,K and optional J; intermediate fractions need not be attainable; full value patterns or known identities can constrain further.
formula_contract.multiple_thresholds: Pointwise endpoint bounds need not be simultaneously attainable by one identity assignment.

implementation.arithmetic: Exact fractions.Fraction; no floating-point arithmetic in bounds implementation
implementation.probability_inputs: int or Fraction excluding bool; floats rejected
implementation.witness_status: Constructed hypothetical endpoint realizations; not estimates of actual identities or multiplicities
implementation.bounds_complexity: Constant number of integer operations, no iteration over N or J; integer bit complexity depends on input magnitude.
implementation.witness_complexity: O(N) entries in worst case; opt-in.

verification.independent_oracle: Enumerates all ordered bounded compositions directly, without ceiling formulas
verification.constructive_tests: N=1..30; K in {1,2,3,5}; all threshold counts; unknown and selected known J
additional_tests: Infeasible threshold despite feasible global totals
verification.meaning: Validation of original deterministic bookkeeping implementation only

figure.data_status: Hypothetical mathematical curves; no empirical points
figure.interpretation: Pointwise envelopes and uniform gap suprema under bounded multiplicity assumptions; finite row totals may tighten bounds.

anchors.paraphrased_finding: One finite numeric result assumed per valid per-run fit; empty subset returns no result.
One invocation per unique clone label within each of run2, run3 and run4.
Combines fitted run rows and assigns a common clone mean without collapsing rows.
Barcoded clone fits are constructed separately and appended before export.
Ancestor substring selector applied to the competition table.
Positive-mean selector on the competition table before plotting.

source_anchor_convention: One-based inclusive source lines; SHA-256 over exact original byte lines including original line endings. Only hashes and paraphrased facts are included.
